reviews.intro.body:
The stories we met at the table —
our meeting connects to your own story.
about.headline:
We place stories on your table.
"Finedining Theater" — an experiential content brand that shares life's stories through food and art.
about.lead:
We believe everyone carries their own story
in a single meal.
about.body:
For some, it's the pork cutlet their father fried for thirty years.
For some, it's the kimbap their mother packed for them.
For some, it's a bowl of rice eaten after a long day's work.
These meals hold the memory of a life.
Finedining Theater
is an experiential content company that shares life's stories through food and art.
We create performances, study food, meet people,
and place their stories on a new table.
And at that table, we hope people can sit face to face again.
about.mission:
We warmly connect people
by sharing life's stories through food and art.
about.values.story.title: We listen to a person's life.
about.values.story.body: Our stories begin in people's lives and memories.
about.values.food.title: We study the tastes held in memory.
about.values.food.body: We bring the time and stories inside food back to today's table.
about.values.together.title: We sit face to face again.
about.values.together.body: Through art and food, we connect people.
about.products.experience.title: Experience content that joins stories and food
about.products.experience.body: We combine performance IP with food to create content that lets people experience a life through story and cuisine.
about.products.cultural.title: A table for companies and organizations
about.products.cultural.body: We create cultural experiences where companies and institutions watch a performance, share a meal, and meet each other in a new way.
about.products.local.title: Content that meets local life
about.products.local.body: We discover the stories that remain in a region's people, food, and places, and create content that can only be experienced there.
about.products.kfood.title: Korean life on the world's table
about.products.kfood.body: We develop the lives and stories of Koreans held in food into performances and experience content to share with more people.
about.products.custom.title: Your story on a new table
about.products.custom.body: We discover the stories of people and spaces held by companies, institutions, and regions, and turn them into tailored experience content.
about.closing:
With a good meal full of life's stories,
we'd like to sit face to face with you again.
about.history.1: We place stories on your table. Finedining Theater is a distribution platform for experience content that combines performance IP and food. Company history: 2026 selected for the Arts Management Support Center's early-stage startup support program. 2026 selected as a short-term resident organization at Art Korea Lab. 2025 Grand Prize at the startup competition of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism and the Arts Management Support Center. 2025 nominated for the Seoul Arts Award by the Seoul Foundation for Arts and Culture. 2024 selected for the ACC Asia Contents creation program: "Fine Dining". Our content: Fine Dining, a gastronomic performance featuring a Western-style pork cutlet. Bread, House (빵, 집), a performance linking the anxiety that ferments in the younger generation with baking. Ms. Park Kyung-ok Is Nowhere and Everywhere (박경옥씨는 어디에도 없고, 어디에나 있다), a performance about loss and recovery. BRUNCH-RUN (브RUN치), a wellness program combining running and food. Table of Memory (기억의 식탁), a social dining program combining art and food. Highlights: Grand Prize at the 2025 Arts Industry Academy startup competition. 700+ cumulative paying audience members. 9.8 audience rating (every performance sold out). Seoul Arts Award nominee (artistic merit recognized at Banjul, December 2025).
about.history.2: A good meal full of life's stories. We empathize through performance, experience through food, and connect through conversation. #comfort #empathy #generations together
about.history.3: Finedining Theater warmly connects people. Performance: we experience the same story together. Gastronomy: we share the same food. Conversation: we expand our experiences into each other's stories. Private Theater Restaurant: with content you can only experience at Finedining Theater, we create time to connect and talk with one another.
story.title: Putting life's stories on the table
story.subtitle: Connecting people through food and art —
story.keywords: People · Stories · Food · Art · Table · Experience
story.cards.people.title: We meet people
story.cards.people.body:
First,
we listen to one person's story.
We meet the time they have lived
and the food that remains in that life.
story.cards.discover.title: We discover life stories
story.cards.discover.body:
In a person's labor and memories,
in family and time,
there are stories not yet told.
We take those stories
as the starting point for new content.
story.cards.food.title: We remember through food
story.cards.food.body:
For some, food is
not just taste but memory.
Inside a single plate
lives a person's time.
story.cards.art.title: We make it through art
story.cards.art.body:
The stories we listen to and record
meet performance and food
and become a new experience.
story.cards.meal.title: A good meal full of life
story.cards.meal.body:
An experience that joins performance and food leads to conversation.
We hope people share each other's stories.
That is why
we value the time we eat together.
story.cards.sitAgain.title: We sit face to face again
story.cards.sitAgain.body:
Good stories
are remembered long with a good meal.
Through food and art,
we create the experience of people sitting face to face again.
trailer.title: Finedining Theater trailer
ft.headline:
Tasting a father's life,
a story on the table
ft.intro:
A daughter follows her father's life.
Thirty years as a diner-style cook.
Even after leaving the kitchen,
he kept on working.
And the diner-style pork cutlet
he used to make.
Performance meets dining —
a time to experience one person's life together.
ft.info.heading: Booking information
ft.info.tagline: An experiential piece combining performance and dining
ft.father.heading: The father's story
ft.father.body:
A man who worked thirty years as a diner-style cook.
The hours spent in the kitchen,
the labor that had to continue for his family.
To his daughter, he was always nearby —
yet perhaps someone she had never truly looked at.
"Finedining – Father's Table" is the story of a daughter
meeting her father's life again,
and finding his time
in the food he made.
ft.labor.heading: The story of labor
ft.labor.body:
A father who was a cook,
and who kept living while doing other work as well.
We look together at the time it takes for a single dish to be made,
and the time one person
has kept working for his family.
ft.labor.alt1: A scene of cooking in the kitchen
ft.cutlet.heading:
There is one person's time
in this pork cutlet.
ft.cutlet.body:
The pork cutlet a father once made,
working as a cook in a 1990s diner-style restaurant.
We remember that taste, research the recipe,
and bring it back to today's table.
This one plate holds not only flavor,
but the years one person lived
and the memory of his labor.
ft.stage.heading:
The moment one life
becomes a performance
ft.stage.body:
The actors do not simply re-enact the father's story.
They remake the memories and feelings that began in one life
into movement, music and story.
The audience crosses the distance between stage and seats
and sits inside the story, together, at one table.
ft.dj.heading:
Share your story
with the Memory DJ
ft.dj.body:
Someone's story,
and the music that brings that moment back.
With the DJ, listen to music,
share stories,
and meet one another's memories.

The piece is completed little by little
as the audience's stories are added.
ft.dj.alt: A performance scene with the Memory DJ
ft.question.heading:
What does fine dining
mean to you?
ft.question.body:
For some, a wonderful meal on a special day.
For others, the pork cutlet their father used to make.
For others, a warm meal shared after long hours of work.
We believe a good meal is not special
because it is expensive or lavish,
but is remembered for a long time
by who sat at the table and what stories were placed on it.
Today, taste a meal that holds one person's life,
and put your own story on the table.
ft.question.alt: A performance scene around the table
ft.banjul.heading:
Meet at a table
holding 52 years of time.
ft.banjul.body:
A place that has made people's meals
in the same spot for a long time.
"Finedining – Father's Table" meets its audience
at Banjul in Jongno.
On top of the time this place has held,
another story is laid.

Today, sit down
at a table that holds someone's life.
